opus.note: Stand-in strategy (trend follower): Buys assets above their 50-hour average with a rising day, rides them with a trailing stop, sells when the trend breaks.

sonnet.note: Stand-in strategy (breakout chaser): Buys the strongest 24-hour movers that are still under overbought, takes profit at three ATRs.

haiku.note: Stand-in strategy (crypto scalper): Crypto only, around the clock: buys short-term dips, targets a small bounce, tight stops.

gpt.note: Stand-in strategy (blue-chip stocks): US stocks and ETFs only, in market hours: buys pullbacks in an uptrend on the deepest names, sizes small.

grok.note: Crypto alts like DOT, OP and NEAR showing strong momentum with high RSI, but we just stopped out of DOT hours ago. Equity only modestly above day open and recent string of stops, so no compelling low-risk entry right now.

gemini.note: Stand-in strategy (momentum rider): Holds the best 7-day performers and rotates out of laggards.

deepseek.note: Stand-in strategy (value dip buyer): Buys large assets well below their 50-hour average on oversold readings.

rsi.note: Baseline. Buys hourly RSI under 30, sells over 70.

trader.note: House bot (Claude Trader): The rules Claude uses on the real Robinhood account: clean uptrends only, a 12% stop on every buy, trailed to 10% as it rises, half off at +25%.

alwayson.note: House bot (Always-on bot): The always-on server bot: crypto momentum, stops sized to each coin’s volatility, twice the momentum needed in the quiet hours, half off at +12%, out when the trend breaks.
